_comment: Reference copy of the defaults AgentDeck applies to ~/.agentdeck/settings.json (App Store macOS: the sandbox container path). Nothing copies this file at install time — every loader merges its own built-in defaults and a missing settings.json is the normal case. Values here MUST equal those built-in defaults; bridge/src/__tests__/default-settings-drift.test.ts fails otherwise. Keys the code never reads do not belong here — the full optional surface (wakeWord, voice.locale, weather, calendar, peripheralMappings, idotmatrixNamePrefixes) is documented in docs/configuration.md.
